evals.prompt: 幫我寫一個 Kling 2.1 Master 的 prompt，我想做一段 10 秒的武俠竹林對決場景，要有電影感跟運鏡。兩個武俠高手對峙，然後出劍。請給我完整 prompt、negative、參數與繁中說明。
evals.expected_output: 正確的 Kling 四/五段式 prompt (英文主)、合理的運鏡選擇（不超過 2 個）、negative prompt、參數建議（時長 10s、aspect、model variant）、繁中說明。應引用 references/kling.md 的公式。

assertions.text: Output includes a complete English prompt with Subject + Action + Scene + Camera + Style structure
Camera motion uses at most 2 movements (not stacked excessively)
Includes a negative prompt section
Specifies duration 10s, aspect ratio, and Kling variant (Master/Pro)
Includes Traditional Chinese explanation of why each prompt part is written that way
Mentions or demonstrates the Kling prompt formula from kling.md reference

evals.prompt: 我有一張我兒子的照片，想做一個 15 秒的影片讓他在花田裡奔跑，笑得很開心。我不確定要用哪個工具。請推薦最合適的 1-2 個平台並給我可以直接用的 prompt。
evals.expected_output: 應先做平台推薦（可能是 Kling I2V 或 Runway Gen-4 References 因角色一致性），解釋原因，然後給該平台的 I2V/Ref2V prompt + 參數。應引用 references/selector.md 的決策樹。

assertions.text: Recommends 1-2 platforms with reasoning
Addresses character consistency since input is a real child's photo
Uses I2V or reference-to-video mode (not pure text-to-video)
Provides ready-to-use English prompt
Prompt focuses on action/motion, not re-describing the child's appearance (I2V best practice)
Mentions at least one safety/consent consideration for using a child's photo

evals.prompt: 幫我用 Suno v5 做一首中文 lo-fi 情歌。歌名叫《夜貓》，想要有完整的 Verse / Pre-Chorus / Chorus / Bridge / Outro 結構，副歌要有情緒爆發感但整體保持溫柔。Style 和 Lyrics 欄都要給我可直接貼的版本。
evals.expected_output: Style 欄 4-8 個 tag 的英文曲風描述；Lyrics 欄完整中文歌詞 + 方括號 metatags（[Verse 1] 等）；分欄清楚；有 top-anchor 技巧的示範；繁中說明為什麼每個 tag 這樣選。

assertions.text: Separates Style field and Lyrics field clearly
Style field contains 4-8 English genre/mood/instrument tags (not Chinese song style description)
Lyrics field uses bracketed metatags [Verse 1], [Chorus], etc.
Lyrics are in Chinese (Traditional or Simplified acceptable)
Includes full song structure: Intro, Verse 1, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Verse 2 or Bridge, Outro
Does not put 'Verse:' without brackets (which would be sung as lyrics)
Includes Traditional Chinese explanation of why tags were chosen

evals.prompt: 我要用 Seedance 做一支 30 秒影片：圖一是唯一主角參考；第一鏡可由 AI 決定服裝，但後續不能換。餐廳裡托盤被撞飛，時間凍結，只有主角能動，接著所有物件沿原軌跡倒轉。請整理成可生成的提示詞，確保人物、髮飾、杯子和複雜液體物理前後一致。
evals.expected_output: 應使用 Seedance 高約束長片架構：參考圖只綁身份、首鏡 deferred binding、不變量帳本、anchor-noun registry、時間碼分鏡、凍結/倒轉事件狀態機、主角與攜帶物的例外集合、分材質物理帳本及分類驗收契約。Seedance 2.0 應將 30 秒拆成 2–3 段並附 Continuation State；若使用者指定 2.5，先核對平台能力，不把 30 秒當成已驗證官方上限。

assertions.text: Treats image 1 as the sole identity/appearance source and does not re-describe the face
Uses deferred binding: first-shot clothing may be generated once, then becomes locked across later shots
Defines an invariant ledger and reuses exact anchor nouns for the signature accessory, glass, and straw
Represents normal motion, collision, freeze, exception, reverse, and restoration as explicit states or equivalent causal stages
Includes the hero's carried props and relevant hair/clothing in the normal-time exception set
Differentiates the physical behavior of thin liquid, viscous sauce, rigid tableware, and solid food
For verified Seedance 2.0, splits the 30-second story into 15-second-or-shorter continuations with a handoff state
Does not claim unverified Seedance 2.5 duration or input limits as official facts
Groups negative constraints by identity, continuity, physics, typography, camera, and ending rather than one undifferentiated list

evals.prompt: 我想用平台標示的 Seedance 2.5 做一支 30 秒直式咖啡 Vlog。主角參考圖只有一張，要像朋友隨手用 MiniDV 拍的，不要精品廣告感。從放下攝影機、磨豆、沖煮、喝一口到最後用手蓋住鏡頭，全程只要現場聲，不要配樂。幫我寫可直接用的 prompt。
evals.expected_output: 先做 provider capability gate，不把 30 秒或 2.5 標籤視為跨平台保證。輸出 observational UGC Production Brief：身份與服裝鎖、start-in-motion、MiniDV 的 autofocus settling／exposure breathing／reframing／camera reaction lag、時間碼事件、raw production sound ledger、hard-cut transition contract、結尾蓋鏡與防止 reference sheet／角色複製的驗收條件。

assertions.text: Checks or explicitly conditions the 30-second plan on the provider's visible Seedance 2.5 capabilities
Uses the reference image for identity without unnecessarily re-describing the subject's face
Starts with an action already in progress rather than a static character-introduction pose
Specifies realistic camera-operator behavior such as reaction lag, imperfect reframing, autofocus settling, or exposure breathing
Uses time-coded beats with one dominant state change and a completed end state per beat
Defines raw production sounds tied to visible events and explicitly excludes background music
Uses one non-contradictory transition contract and defines the final lens-cover ending
Excludes reference-sheet framing, subject duplication, captions, logos, and watermarks

evals.prompt: 我要用 Seedance 做一段兩人對話。圖一是 A、圖二是 B，音訊一是 A 的聲音、音訊二是 B 的聲音。兩人先同框，再各自反打講一句，最後回到雙人鏡。臉、服裝、聲線不能交換，也不要字幕。請用最穩的格式寫。
evals.expected_output: 輸出 reference job cards 和 conflict precedence，分別綁定兩人的 identity/outfit 與 voice；建立左右位置、視線與空間鎖；以 two-shot、over-shoulder、reverse、final two-shot 的時間碼安排 dialogue owner、exact line、delivery、pause、listening reaction 與 lip-sync；附 audio ledger、end state 與 speaker-swap／duplicate／captions exclusions。若平台版本或素材槽位未確認，先通過 capability gate。

assertions.text: Creates explicit job cards for each image and audio reference instead of saying to use all references generally
Defines conflict precedence and keeps each character's identity, outfit, and voice bound to the correct source
Locks screen position, eyelines, and room geography across two-shot and reverse shots
Assigns each exact line to one dialogue owner with delivery, pause, and lip-sync instructions
Includes silent listening reactions so both characters do not speak or move independently at once
Defines a clear final two-shot end state
Excludes speaker swap, face drift, duplicate characters, captions, and extra dialogue
Does not assume provider-specific duration or reference limits without checking the visible model capabilities

evals.prompt: 用 Seedance 2.5 幫建商做一支樣品屋影片。我有平面圖、白模、材質 moodboard，想一鏡從玄關走到主臥，畫面要高級，還要加不存在的海景讓案子更好賣。
evals.expected_output: 拒絕把不存在的海景包裝成真實建案，區分 concept visualization 與 actual-property marketing。先做 capability gate，將平面圖、白模、材質與 camera route 分別綁定；鎖牆、門窗、房間鄰接、尺度與單一採光方向；定義人眼高度、可行走動線、不可穿牆與最後示意標示 safe zone。

assertions.text: Separates concept visualization from actual-property marketing and does not invent an unapproved ocean view
Assigns separate reference jobs to the floor plan, white model, material board, and optional camera route
Locks walls, doors, windows, room adjacency, scale, and one consistent lighting direction
Defines a physically walkable route at human eye height with no wall penetration or impossible indoor drone move
Leaves a clean safe zone for an editor-added concept disclaimer instead of generating legal text
Conditions 30-second, 4K, reference limits, and editing features on the visible provider capability

evals.prompt: 我有一張電動車產品照，要做 15 秒雨夜汽車廣告：車燈亮起、側面高速跟拍、輪圈特寫，最後停成 hero shot。車型、輪圈和 Logo 都不能變。
evals.expected_output: 走 I2V，產品照只負責車身 master，prompt 主要描述動態。建立車身、軸距、四輪、燈組、玻璃、徽標與車牌區的幾何鎖；時間碼分配車燈、lateral tracking、輪圈 insert 與 clean hold；寫輪胎接地、輪速、懸吊、反射與雨水物理，排除多輪、熔車、滑行與錯字 Logo。

assertions.text: Uses image-to-video and treats the product photo as the exact vehicle geometry master
Locks body proportions, wheelbase, four-wheel count, wheel design, lamps, glasshouse, badges, and plate area
Uses distinct time blocks for lamp wake-up, lateral tracking, wheel insert, and final hero hold
Defines tire contact, wheel rotation, suspension response, reflections, and rain spray as physical behavior
Excludes extra wheels, changing badges, melted panels, floating tires, and sliding without wheel rotation
Keeps exact Logo/text from the reference or schedules it for post rather than trusting generated typography

evals.prompt: 幫餐廳做一支 15 秒豬排咖哩 Reels：切開酥脆豬排、冒熱氣、淋咖哩、叉子拉起一口，最後要有完整擺盤。不要看起來像塑膠食物。
evals.expected_output: 用 9:16 macro hard-cut 結構與 plating reference lock，分時段安排切開、蒸氣、單次醬汁淋下、叉子抬起與 hero plate。建立外皮、肉、咖哩、蒸氣、瓷盤不同物理；鎖食材數量與盤面，避免無限拉絲、錯誤蒸氣、刀叉穿透、塑膠表面和額外手指。

assertions.text: Locks the exact plating, ingredient count, plate geometry, and final hero composition
Uses one dominant food action per time block and ends every block in a completed state
Differentiates crust, meat fibers, viscous curry, steam, ceramic, and utensil physics
Uses appetizing but physically motivated side lighting and avoids neon oversaturation or plastic surfaces
Ties knife crack, sizzle, sauce contact, and room tone to visible events
Excludes duplicated garnish, impossible steam, endless stretch, utensil penetration, extra fingers, generated menu text, and fade

evals.prompt: 我要做 Seedance 影片，題材可能是企業形象、產品廣告、電影概念或原創動畫。請告訴我這四種不能共用哪些寫法，並各給一個最小可用 prompt 骨架。
evals.expected_output: 依 seedance-domain-playbook 分流：企業片鎖真流程與聲明，產品片鎖 packshot 幾何並走 I2V，電影片鎖 dramatic state 與角色表演，動畫片鎖 silhouette／比例／palette／材質／timing。四者共用 capability gate、reference jobs、單一主事件、audio owner 與 clean hold，但不能只換主詞使用同一 generic cinematic prompt。

assertions.text: Explains that corporate, product, film, and animation prompts require different truth, geometry, story, and style invariants
Corporate skeleton forbids invented clients, metrics, certifications, UI, and process claims
Product skeleton prioritizes an exact packshot master, motion-only I2V direction, and a final clean hold
Film skeleton includes state before, observable event, state after, performance, dialogue ownership, and continuity
Animation skeleton locks silhouette, scale, proportions, palette, line or material system, and timing signature
All skeletons retain provider capability gating and do not claim announced Seedance 2.5 features are universally executable
